_note: store: every frame's zero point, append-only JSON lines; status: what the console (and so the notifier) reads.
sky: the per-port photometry (efficiency chains, the measured T2 FAU zero point) the expected zero point comes from.
expected 'chain': efficiency is measured against the efficiency chain alone (whose factors are ESTIMATED: the ratio
is meaningful as a trend, its absolute value only once the chain is measured). 'zero_point' uses a measured zero point.
default_port: robofast's own frames carry PORT; a frame without one is the imager's.
extinction: mag per airmass, ESTIMATED (0.15 is a typical V value at ~2.3 km; Gaia G and the imager filters differ);
fit_extinction fits it per series from steady nights with an airmass range and uses the fit once it is good
Thresholds are the defaults (alarm 10 % below the baseline; step up 5 % on 2 steady nights; step down 10 % on 4).
